Nothing changed this run, so I stopped right away instead of spending a try. The code part of this job is finished and has been in the game since 10-22, builds v34.13 to v34.16, and it covers all six steps of the brief. What's still open is re-measuring the speed. That needs the coord-07 test scripts (`runA.sh` and `runC.sh`) driving a test Chrome, and those commands aren't on my allowed list. The results folder `notes/coord-07/94-ladder-after` still doesn't exist, so I have no new numbers. I didn't make any up.

- **Old numbers, to compare against later:** 1 player (A-t4) p50 40.8 ms, p95 50.1 ms. 2-player demo (C-t4): host window p50 148.5, p95 187.1; player 2 window p50 146.7, p95 217.6.
- **What it needs:** the coordinator has to run the prepared `measure-A.sh` and `measure-C.sh`, then `measure-summary.ps1`, on a lane's own port (never 8802). The 2-player run can go on the spare PC.
- **Suggestion:** this is the third lane run in a row today, and runs before that, that hit the same wall. Re-queuing it to a lane won't help. It should go to the coordinator, or be closed once the numbers are in.
- **Watch line for his next play:** a raid that gets softer or loses sparks while nothing is happening, or sparks or haze that come and go. The first 20 seconds of each raid should look like the rest.

I added this run to `tools/handoff/console/notes/94-ladder-sheds-sooner.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: same blocker as before. The coord-07 re-measure needs `runA.sh`/`runC.sh` and the Chrome scripts, which are not on my command list, so the coordinator has to run them.
